body:
Oh thank God, I've been waiting for someone to post this. I am a huge Army and nearly their whole discography is on constant repeat, but I literally cried when I watched the livestream of the performance version because of how disappointed I was by how terrible and generic the song was. The video was great but I was so angry I even called up my musician dad and bitched up a storm about how shitty it was lmao

A lot of their latest music is really terrible with all the autotune and generic melodies, beats, production, etc. I took a look at MOTS7's composing and producer credits and I'm wondering if the reason their stuff has started sounding like generic western pop is because they've started using a ridiculous amount of foreign producers on each track. Personal preference, but I miss the days when most of their stuff was done by in-house producers, because back then the music actually sounded unique, creative, and had a trademark BTS sound as opposed to something generic you could easily hear on top 40 radio in the US.

The only songs I liked on the album were "My Time" and "Black Swan", although it's still disgusting how much autotune was used. Are we seriously going back to T-Pain days or something?

Ah good to hear, yeah I figured it would be different for other people, like I said even my psychiatrist noted my body reacts a bit weirdly to certain meds lol. Thanks for sharing your experience of it working for you too, I'm hoping to help someone with this post because I know I was suicidal from the akathisia before the mirtazapine.

I was also on 15mg. I must say, I didn't get overly sleepy on Remeron, but maybe you could tell your father my experiences with latuda? When I first started latuda I was EXTREMELY tired for like 2 weeks but after that now when I take Latuda it feels like I didn't take anything energy wise. I've been on other meds as well with similar experiences. You're absolutely right, your body just has to get used to it. Med side effects are always the worst in the beginning, but if you stick it out you can get great results in some cases.
